description: This file defines the MyNotesDashlet class, which extends the DashletGeneric class to create a custom dashboard widget for displaying notes in the SuiteCRM application. It includes constructor logic that loads dashlet data and sets up configurations such as title, search fields, columns, and seed bean initialization.

classes.name: MyNotesDashlet
classes.description: A custom dashlet class for displaying and managing notes within SuiteCRM dashboard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the dashlet, loads dashlet data, and sets configuration options.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes MyNotesDashlet, loads configuration data, and sets default title if not provided.
